findings.text: _state_equilibrium is a copy of the helper defined at nova/equilibrium/moment.py:1092 and inlined a third time at nova/equilibrium/profile.py:790, while benchmarks/estimator_scoreboard.py:280 (state_from_record) and nova/imas/pulsedesign.py:540 (equilibrium_ids) already own the same equilibrium-IDS assembly; the three copies already diverge in how boundary.type is set, so a change to the IDS convention must now be made in three places. Fold into a follow-up node that extracts one shared reconstruction-to-IMAS writer.

profile_equilibrium re-reads the boundary with host_boundary_read(..., lcfs_norm=1.0) and writes read.psi_axis/read.psi_bnd, discarding ProfileResult.boundary_flux (profile.py:555, from the solve's own traced_smooth_boundary_read at profile.py:416); the docstring claims the boundary read the profile iteration itself uses, which is a different function at a different level, so the column's axis- and boundary-flux margins are not the reconstruction's own stored extrema. Fix by writing result.boundary_flux (and the result's axis) or by using the same read the iteration uses, and correct the docstring.

the harmonic test passes vacuum_flux=np.zeros_like(flux_field()), so the conversion's only non-trivial operation, total = inversion.flux_on_grid(...) + vacuum_flux at harmonic.py:714, is unguarded: deleting the added vacuum term leaves every assertion true; and the map-withheld branch stored_map = ... if np.isfinite(read.axis_psi) else None at harmonic.py:752, which produces the published 'q95 not supplied', is untested. A regression in either changes the harmonic column and no test reddens.

__all__ is declared at line 722 and the diff appends profile_equilibrium and write_profile_equilibrium after it without adding them, so the module's declared public API omits its new conversions and 'from nova.equilibrium.profile import *' cannot reach them.

the three reconstruction columns name pre-materialised state directories under ~/.cache, and the driver that ran the reconstructions and wrote those states (with acceptance_control.py) is not committed, so the states behind the receipt's digests cannot be regenerated from the repository; fold the driver into a committed benchmark or script in a follow-up node.

the three control columns use perturbed_of, which emit_perturbed_states (benchmarks/estimator_scoreboard.py:340) resolves by copying the already-written equilibrium through perturb_state (estimator_scoreboard.py:93); the perturbed state therefore never enters through each new column's conversion as the plan's clause (3) words it, so the control shows the scoreboard rejects a perturbed state but does not exercise the conversions' own boundary read and ring construction.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production caller exists at the reviewed head; git grep for the three write_*_equilibrium names returns only their definitions at harmonic.py:818, moment.py:1140 and profile.py:819, and the driver that did call them is uncommitted scratch.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit: 6e66c5882 adds the three conversions and the test file, aeda56d56 and 661a622c0 add the evidence fragment and its suite-arm record; nothing outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's three clauses are each addressed: the table at table-reduced-reconstructions-scored.html carries digest and all three reference-free checks per column, the margins table states every band with its limit and measured value, and the negative control at cases-reduced-reconstructions-scored.json:39-52 fails every scoreable band.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to score the harmonic, moment and profile reconstructions as their own columns on the section 3 scoreboard, and docs/figures/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/estimator-scoreboard/receipt-reduced-reconstructions-scored.json:22 scores all three plus three controls on the row-exchange case.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest records status complete, three commits, both suite arms with revisions and EXIT=0, the negative-control log and per-column results with margins.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the eight delivered paths are all inside the declared write paths, with nova/equilibrium/profile.py covered by the manifest's scope_note.

justifications.durability: tests/test_reduced_reconstruction_columns.py:131-140 pins the harmonic map but passes vacuum_flux=np.zeros_like(flux_field()), so harmonic.py:714's added vacuum flux and harmonic.py:752's withheld-map branch are both unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite record 48->51 passed at revisions 06d7280/aeda56d5 with EXIT=0 in both logs, and the negative-control log exits 1 failing all three controls, but the driver that wrote the three reconstruction states is uncommitted (cases-reduced-reconstructions-scored.json:22-32 names only cache paths).
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/profile.py:722 declares __all__ and the diff appends the new public conversions after it without listing them, so the module's declared API omits its own additions.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/inverse-equilibrium-baseline/reduced-reconstructions-scored.html scores all three reconstructions as their own column groups on the iter-row-exchange-nominal case with digest, the state source and all three reference-free checks, and states every failing band with its margin.
justifications.reuse: nova/equilibrium/harmonic.py:770 duplicates one IDS-assembly helper already defined at nova/equilibrium/moment.py:1092 and inlined a third time at nova/equilibrium/profile.py:790, while benchmarks/estimator_scoreboard.py:280 owns the same capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the coordinator's declared paths, and the one path in the diff outside the node record's orientation list (nova/equilibrium/profile.py) carries the required scope_note in the manifest.
